text:
marta: Uploaded the latest mock for eval-run stage visibility — link: https://figma.redwood/mock-eval-stages
aria-bot: new mock uploaded by marta :package:
ken: quick thought — the 'Staged' badge is too subtle, hard to scan when you have 40 runs. maybe bolder weight or a left color stripe? :eyes:
marta: I want to avoid adding a lot of visual noise. what if we add a tiny icon + clearer label so it reads 'Staged' with an inline dot?
ria: main UX gap: the bulk action CTA in the toolbar just says 'Approve'. ambiguous whether it applies to selected items or the whole page. suggest 'Approve selected runs' or 'Approve 3 selected'.
sam: +1 to explicit 'selected' wording. also suggest a confirmation for large batches (>10) to reduce accidental clicks.
ken: accessibility nit — current success toast disappears too fast and isn't announced to screen readers. we should use a live region and ensure it gets focus or role=status.
alex: proposed modal copy: 'Mark 12 runs as approved? This will update their status and notify reviewers.' buttons: 'Cancel' / 'Approve 12' — keeps the action explicit.
marta: tweak: avoid passive voice — 'Mark 12 runs as approved and notify reviewers.' shorter and clearer.
ria: keyboard flow: after closing the confirm modal focus should return to the batch toolbar (so keyboard users can continue). currently focus lands on the page body. Esc should close the modal too — it doesn't right now.
sam: backend note — bulk approve currently fires one request per run. can we batch into a single endpoint to reduce client churn? alex can you check?
alex: yep I'll investigate batching; if backend can accept an array we can do one call. I'll follow up in eng-runtime.
ken: visual a11y: add a clear focus ring on selected rows and ensure the Staged/Approved badges meet WCAG AA contrast in both light/dark. I left an explicit contrast value in Figma comments.
marta: can someone mock the updated modal microcopy + focus states by EOD? I can iterate spacing and the inline icon.
ria: left targeted Figma comments (contrast + keyboard order). flagged the confirmation copy for tone — prefer direct, action-oriented phrasing.
ken: will update the badge color and add alt text to the icon.
aria-bot: Figma comments summary: https://figma.redwood/comments/abc123
sam: next steps: marta updates mock & copies, alex checks backend batching, ken updates color + focus styles, ria finalizes copy. if anything stalls we can sync tomorrow 10:00am PT.
marta: thanks all — I'll post the updated mock here when ready.
